principles.text: With feature parity, the product with better marketing and distribution wins every time.
Early on, use transactional channels like paid ads and cold email that produce revenue tomorrow, not revenue six months out.
An agent is software with a thinking loop and a live data stream, built to repeat a process a human already ran.
Hand the middle work to agents. You supply the idea and the polish, and your domain vocabulary is the leverage.
The ad creative is the targeting: test many ads, kill losers in two to three days, and let winners compete for budget.

sampleQA.question: Which channels should an early-stage founder start with?

answer.text: Pick from paid ads, cold email, cold DMs and founder-led social. He says most companies can reach $1M ARR with only two channels, and you need revenue tomorrow.
Leave SEO, email newsletters, podcast guesting and a YouTube channel off that first list.
Focus everything on one channel until you see its ceiling, then layer on the next.
Arbitrage fades. In one example a signup went from $1 to $5 in 12 months, which is why he later adds a content flywheel.

sampleQA.question: How do I set up an agent to run Facebook ads?

answer.text: Put ads, analytics, CRM and Stripe data in one warehouse so the agent can tie a specific ad to revenue.
Do analysis only from the warehouse and use the Facebook API only for writes: upload, pause, promote. Spamming the API for reads violates its terms.
Target broadly and take angles from language customers already use on forums like Reddit, because under Andromeda the creative is the targeting.
Publish new ads daily, let them run two to three days, turn off losers, and move winners into a pool that competes for budget.

sampleQA.question: How do I get good content out of AI instead of slop?

answer.text: Treat it as a guardrails problem. Give the agent a definition of good content, brand guides and banned language.
Scrape the page-one results for the topic, add a 30-minute interview of yourself with your opinions and experiences, then write from both.
Without source material and a defined direction, AI output regresses to the average.
